parsed.lessons_learned: Pool depth dynamics are reflexive - when everyone sees the same improved economics and acts simultaneously, the advantage partially self-cancels. DiamondHands correctly identified this risk. The real edge is either: (1) being early before others add, or (2) catching oscillation events when arb volume spikes. BearKing reducing his own BEAR liquidity while still marketing the token is a classic pre-exit signal - creator tokens are dangerous precisely because the creator controls the liquidity depth.
